subject: Next steps: Connect with Redwood Inference — schedule link inside
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Reyes <jordan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks for signing up — quick link to schedule

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for signing up and taking Redwood for a spin — appreciate the interest. I dropped a few resources below and a short calendar link so we can lock in a 20-minute demo and make sure we focus on the parts that matter for your team (latency profile, on-prem options, and cost controls).

Quick next steps:
- Book a 20-min demo: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/20min-demo
- If you prefer a technical deep-dive, pick the “Technical walkthrough” option in the picker and we’ll include an engineer.
- Optional: fill the 1-minute pre-demo questionnaire so we tailor the demo: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-pre-demo-questionnaire

I’m attaching a one-pager with common deployment patterns and pricing tiers for reference. If you’d rather reply with times that work this week, hit reply and cc Ava (our SDR) and she’ll take it from there.

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 280KB)

Thanks — look forward to connecting.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference

Thanks Sean — appreciate the materials. I tried the Calendly link but the earliest availability is next Wednesday and we were hoping to see something earlier. Is there any chance you or someone on your team has a 30-minute slot tomorrow afternoon? We want to include our infra lead (she’s in the 1–4pm PT window).

Also, is the one-pager safe to share with our procurement folks?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Reyes

jordan@acmecloud.com

Hi Jordan — Ava from Redwood here, looping in to help set something sooner. Glad you flagged the infra lead — that’s useful to know. I have the following windows tomorrow (PT) that I can hold:

- 11:30am–12:00pm
- 1:00pm–1:30pm
- 3:00pm–3:30pm

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom and include the technical engineer from our side. If none are good, here’s a direct scheduling link that also supports adding an extra attendee: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/20min-demo?add=attendee

The one-pager is fine to share internally; it’s a high-level product and pricing summary. For procurement-level details we usually follow up with an NDA and a short procurement packet (I can send that after the demo).

Suggested agenda for the 30-min call:
1) Quick intro & use case (5)
2) Live demo focused on latency & deployment modes (15)
3) Q&A & next steps (10)

Would 1:00pm PT work to include your infra lead? If yes I’ll block it and share the Zoom link.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Sales Development Rep, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.ai
